name: Dogs
description: Dogs word search puzzles for calm afternoons with or without a companion at your feet. Free online grids use everyday dog vocabulary — walks, parks, coats, leashes, kennels and quiet training words — without breed-club branding or cartoon characters. Choose easy, medium or hard difficulty. Progress stays in your browser so you can pause and return. The Larger grid size is available whenever bigger letters feel better. Short words such as sit, paw and toy keep easy boards friendly; longer anchors like companion, harness and pawprint steady harder ones. Pair with Cats, Animals or Farm Animals for a wider pet hour, and open Large Print when you want fewer words on a 9×9 grid. Written for adults and seniors, not for licensed mascot kits.
